tools.name: search_ai_companies
tools.description: Find AI startups and companies by topic, sector, country, funding stage, founding year or whether they are hiring. Example: query 'clinical documentation', country 'Australia'. Returns name, one-liner, sector, country, funding facts, website and the presentofai.com page to cite.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Full public profile of one company by slug (from search_ai_companies): description, founders, funding facts, open roles, recent news and source links.

tools.name: list_sectors_countries
tools.description: The sectors and countries that can be used as filters, with company counts. Call this first if unsure how a sector or country is spelled.

tools.name: find_ai_jobs
tools.description: Open roles at AI companies, searchable by keyword, company, function (Engineering, Product, Sales, AI & Data, ...) and place (city, country or Remote).

tools.name: latest_ai_news
tools.description: Dated, source-linked AI news events, newest first, optionally filtered by keyword or company. Each item links to the primary source and to our article.

tools.name: whats_trending
tools.description: Topics currently trending across AI companies we track (with example companies and latest news) and the companies hiring the most.
